---
title: "Xing — Prognostic Scoring in HRS-AKI"
---

## Project Summary

This sub-project of the HARMONY Terlipressin Registry evaluates the discriminative ability of prognostic scoring systems in patients with hepatorenal syndrome-acute kidney injury (HRS-AKI) treated with terlipressin.

### Scores Compared

- **MELD** (Model for End-Stage Liver Disease)
- **MELD-Na** (MELD with sodium correction)
- **MELD 3.0** (updated MELD incorporating albumin and sex)
- **CLIF-C** (Chronic Liver Failure Consortium score)

### Outcomes

- **Primary:** 90-day mortality from terlipressin initiation
- **Secondary:** HRS treatment response (`hrs_responders_cat_2`)

### Methods

- Cox proportional hazards models for each score
- Time-dependent ROC curves (timeROC) at days 7, 15, 30, 60, 89
- Logistic regression ROC for HRS response prediction
- Pairwise AUC comparisons (DeLong test and timeROC::compare)

### Key Design Decisions

- Survival time is anchored at **terlipressin initiation (day 0)**, not hospital admission
- Scores recalculated from **day-0 labs** (not admission labs)
- Missing labs handled via **median imputation** before score calculation
